description: Explicit read/write permissions matrix. Enforces that only SUPRA-Builder can mutate files.

SUPRA-Architect.reason: Executive and Fusion roles. No write capability needed.

SUPRA-Builder.reason: SOLE mutation agent. All file changes go through Builder.

SUPRA-Auditor.reason: Auditor and Validator roles. Read-only analysis.

SUPRA-Reviewer.reason: Comparator role. Review is read-only by nature.

SUPRA-Explorer.reason: Explorer role. Navigation is inherently read-only.

SUPRA-Research.reason: Research and Benchmark roles. Information gathering only.

SUPRA-Runtime.reason: Runtime diagnostics. Bash allowed for execution analysis only.

SUPRA-Refactor.reason: Refactoring analysis only. Mutations delegated to Builder.

SUPRA-Router.reason: Planner and Router roles. Selects, routes, does not write.

write_request_protocol.description: When a read-only agent needs a file mutation, it must:
steps: 1. Submit a write request to the Mission Center
2. Specify: target file, mutation type (create/modify/delete), content/change
4. Request is forwarded to SUPRA-Builder for execution
5. Builder applies the mutation and reports back

violation_handling.detection: Any attempt by a non-Builder agent to call edit/write/create/delete operations
violation_handling.action: Block the operation, log the violation, notify Mission Center
violation_handling.recovery: Route the intended mutation to SUPRA-Builder via the write request protocol
